newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Deputy PM Ciller says no early elections.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Deputy PM Ciller says no early elections.

text.p: Turkey's Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller on Friday ruled out early elections despite a call from the Islamist wing of the coalition for polls to clear up a row between the government and the army.
Asked by reporters if there would be early elections, Ciller said: "There will be no such thing. The government will continue."
State Minister Abdullah Gul, a close aide of Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan, made a call in comments published on Friday for general elections.
"At a time when Turkey is choked, the democratic system is being squeezed and pressure is mounting, we have to go to elections. That is my personal opinion, " the Milliyet daily quoted Gul as saying.
Turkey's powerful National Security Council last weekend ordered Erbakan to stamp out Islamist activity it says endangers Turkey's secularism.
The opposition refused to back the government against the generals, forcing Erbakan to reluctantly approve the military statement urging a crackdown.
